description: We are Cosmic Catalysts, a team working on the Flame in Freefall challenge. Our goal is to use AI to analyze microgravity combustion data and turn it into fire safety insights for Moon and Mars missions. We are learning Python, data analysis, and dashboard building. We're looking for teammates with skills in Python/pandas, Streamlit or web design, and presentation/storytelling. Passion for learning matters most. Everyone is welcome!
